host.description: IP address (IPv4/IPv6) the Argus server binds to. Use `0.0.0.0` to listen on all interfaces.

port.description: TCP port number for theArgus API and management interface.

log_dir.description: Absolute path to the directory where audit logs are written.

ssl_enabled.description: Whether to enable TLS encryption for client connections.

ssl_cert.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (PEM format). Required if `ssl_enabled` is true.

ssl_key.description: Path to the SSL private key file (PEM format). Required if `ssl_enabled` is true.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections the server accepts.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before a client connection is closed.

db.description: Database configuration for storing audit records.

path.description: File path for SQLite database (used only if `type` = `sqlite`).

ssl_mode.description: PostgreSQL SSL mode (optional, used only if `type` = `postgresql`).

audit_rules.description: List of audit rules to define which transactions to capture and log.

description.description: Human-readable description of the rule’s purpose.

protocol.description: Network protocol this rule applies to.

ports.description: List of TCP/UDP ports to monitor (e.g., `[80, 443]`). Required for `tcp` and `udp`.

log_to.description: Where to store matched transaction records.

alerts.email_enabled.description: Whether to send audit alerts via email.

alerts.smtp_server.description: SMTP server hostname for sending alerts (used only if `email_enabled` is true).

alerts.smtp_port.description: SMTP server port (typically 587 for TLS, 465 for SSL).

alerts.to_addrs.description: List of recipient email addresses for alerts.

alerts.webhook_enabled.description: Whether to send audit alerts to HTTP(S) webhooks.

method.description: HTTP method to use when sending payload.

alerts.webhooks.description: List of webhook destinations for alerts (used only if `webhook_enabled` is true).
